added.summary: A dense smoked plate over a dark scrim, lit along its top in the accent; when danger is set the edge is red and a "Cannot be undone" kicker stands over the question. Cancel is a glass plate and the confirming action the lit plate, red for a destructive one. New part confirm.kicker; new string table confirm.en.ogt with screen.confirm.undone.

The step card is an accent-lit plate: the step count as a kicker beside a thin progress line, the title, the text (never clamped: the card grows), Skip in type and Next as the lit plate. New parts tutorial.track and tutorial.fill.

Draws on its own smoked plate. A row is type, washed in the accent from a lit leading edge under the pointer or the focus; a shortcut sits on a dark key chip, a check is drawn in the accent, the chosen radio is a lit diamond, a disabled row is faint and a destructive one red. A long command wraps between its words; rows keep 44 px targets under a coarse pointer.
Dim links, faint chevrons, the current page bold on a lit underline. The trail wraps between crumbs and a long name wraps between its words; crumbs keep 44 px targets under a coarse pointer.

The item's card is a smoked plate lit along its top and tinted at its head in its rarity's colour, the icon in an octagon socket; figures are condensed and tabular, a change carries its triangle and sign in green or red, an added or removed stat a chip. What is equipped stands beside it on a plainer plate, and under it on a narrow screen. Long names and stats wrap between words.

The choices dock at the foot over a shade, under a thin lit line that drains with the time left. A choice is a cut smoked plate whose words wrap whole; the chosen one is ringed and washed in the accent, an unavailable one flat and dim but readable (4.5:1), a quick-time one carries a gold bar. A hotspot is four lit brackets round a faint wash. New part film-choices.shade.

Over a veil: chapters and endings are cut stills with the name under the picture, where a long name wraps whole. The selected one is ringed and lit; one not reached is a hatched dark well under a lock. An ending found carries a gold diamond. The grid fills whole columns and scrolls. New parts shade, plate and lock on both, and film-gallery.mark.

Over a veil; the picked node sits on an accent-lit plate under a "Selected" kicker, its words whole beside Play from here, which drops under them on a narrow screen. New parts film-flowchart.shade and film-flowchart.kicker; new string screen.film-flowchart.selected.

breaking.change: Cancel is no longer the quiet variant (it is a default button with class plate), and the dialog sets its own panel fill, edge and backdrop from the --dialog-* roles.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed the quiet Cancel dresses #Cancel or ::part(confirm.actions) button; one that dressed the panel sets --dialog-fill, --dialog-edge and --dialog-scrim.

breaking.change: The menu's frame is no longer bare: it draws its own plate, and its rows are type, not row-role strips.
breaking.fix: A game that stood Menu in a panel of its own removes that panel's fill, or sets --dialog-fill to none on the menu.

breaking.change: screen.tutorial.Step now reads "Tutorial · {step} / {steps}" and stands at the card's head, not beside the actions.
breaking.fix: A game that wants the bare count overrides screen.tutorial.Step in its string table.

breaking.change: A rarity no longer draws the frame's rim through --frame-rim and --frame-rim-width. The card sets --frame-fill and --frame-shadow (a lit top edge and a tinted head) and the socket's --well-fill and --well-shadow from --rarity; --title-ink is still the rarity's colour.
breaking.fix: A style that recoloured a rarity sets --rarity on ::part(TooltipCard.frame), or the palette's rarity colours; one that drew its own rim on the card sets --frame-shadow there.

breaking.change: The choices' panel is bare (no HUD plate behind them). A chapter or ending card is no longer a raised panel, and one not reached draws part lock (a well and a lock icon) in place of its thumb art.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed the choices' panel dresses ::part(film-choices.shade); one that dressed a locked card's thumb dresses ::part(film-chapters.lock) or ::part(film-gallery.lock).

fixed.summary: A delta that starts with + is drawn in the better green (class up) and one that starts with - in the worse red (new class down); an unsigned delta is plain. Every delta used to draw red, because the test for the leading sign never matched.
